identification_key: Lobby and battle-bar portraits carry no names. Cookies are named by element icon + art, cross-checked against the author's subtitles and the rune-page titles: 브라이트시커 = light shooter, brown hair, purple eye (rune page 브라이트시커 쿠키, RKNiw1fRosw-01m16.5s.jpg); 샤르도네 = grass support, pink/lilac hair with green streak (gacha card 샤르도네맛 쿠키, 풀속성 지원, RKNiw1fRosw-00m10.0s.jpg; rune page 샤르도네맛 쿠키, RKNiw1fRosw-02m03.5s.jpg); 전갈 = fire shooter, red hair; 피노누아 = dark, grey hair, monocle; 석류 = dark, red curly hair; 정글전사 = grass, teal hair, orange flower; 다크초코 = dark defense, black/red hair; 메론소다 = water shooter, green hair, goggles; 치즈케이크 = light, yellow hair; 피겨여왕 = water, yellow face with purple earmuffs (named 피겨 in the ATK-order subtitle; the only other water cookie is 메론소다); 우유 = light, white nurse with pink bear and the leader banner; 실론나이트 = light defense, white-bearded knight. Star display: the card shows five stars, gold for the first five and turning pink one by one for 6★–10★. This reading is checked against rune-line locks: Chardonnay and Tea Knight show all-gold stars and still have their ★6 rune line locked; Brightseeker shows 1 pink + 4 gold with 4 open lines and ★8 lines locked; Tiger Lily shows 4 pink + 1 gold with 6 open lines and ★10 lines locked. Stars below are given as the visible colours plus the star count this reading implies.

posts.summary_en: 서신우 runs a 3.89G-power Melon Soda deck with Chardonnay (Lv.118, 5★) in Macaron's slot and scores 2,501,105,826,814 (≈2.50T, ≈643배), guild rank 1st, raising his personal best from 2T 217G by 284G 77M. Pinot, Tiger Lily and Dark Choco stay at Lv.1, Scorpion is Lv.65 and Melon Soda Lv.78 for ATK ordering, everyone else is Lv.114–118. All 12 cookies are still alive at 16.967, 11.967 and 5.967 on the timer; by 4.967 only Pomegranate and Skating Queen remain, and both survive to 0.000. Sugar runes are shown for every cookie except Scorpion and Cheesecake; Chardonnay has only 3 open lines, all 스증.
